review_evidence: README identifies the project as an ongoing formalization of the Hasse-Minkowski theorem from Women in Numbers 7.
Modules contain rational and p-adic approximation results and Hilbert-symbol lemmas including symmetry, square invariance, and characterization theorems.
The primary Lean files form the mathematical development; no generated-only subtree was identified.
summary: Retain HassePrinciple: an active Hasse-Minkowski formalization with local and global number-theory definitions and proofs.
